subject: Renewal sync: scaling sprint & usage runway for Satellite Labs
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reed <alex.reed@satellitelabs.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal sync: scaling sprint & usage runway for Satellite Labs

Alex —

Thanks again for the time last week. I wanted to put a short note in the thread with the immediate usage posture we observed (attached) and three pragmatic paths for the upcoming renewal so we can align on next steps.

Quick summary:
- August spend jumped ~2.3x vs July driven by increased OCR + image-captioning inference in your ingestion pipeline (route: /v1/generate-image-caption).
- Peak hourly tokens hit ~420k tokens/hr on 8/21; tail latency held within SLA (~220ms p95) so ops looks stable.
- Current punctuated growth makes month-to-month risky for forecasted Q4 features.

Why this matters for the renewal: larger variability = higher overage exposure. We want to offer a predictable, lower-cost path that still lets Satellite iterate rapidly.

Options to consider (short):
1) 12-month committed baseline (40M tokens/mo) + 25% burst buffer. Unit price: $0.00055/token; includes 99.9% uptime SLA and 30-day rolling autoscale credits.
2) 6-month step-down commit (start 30M tokens/mo, step to 50M in month 4) with blended pricing. Good if you want to tie to the product roadmap.
3) No commit: month-to-month with overage tiers. Higher unit cost but max flexibility.

I've attached: satellite_usage_aug2026.csv (detailed per-route / model tokens), satellite_perf_report_q3.pdf (latency & error profile), renewal_pricing_v2.xlsx (line-item pricing + sample invoice).

Ask: could you confirm which option you prefer and whether procurement needs an initial mock invoice this week? If helpful, Ben and Laura can run a short ROI sketch showing expected token cost delta vs your internal forecast.

Proposed internal ask: I can escalate a 10% introductory concession on option 1 for a signed 12-month commitment before 9/20.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20min call if helpful.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: satellite_usage_aug2026.csv (CSV), satellite_perf_report_q3.pdf (PDF), renewal_pricing_v2.xlsx (Excel)
From: Alex Reed <alex.reed@satellitelabs.ai>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal sync: scaling sprint & usage runway for Satellite Labs

Sean —

Thanks for the clear options and the attachments. A couple quick asks so we can move internally:
- Can you break out the August spike by model and route (gpt-large-image vs gpt-medium-text; captioning vs chat)? We need line-levels for our internal chargeback.
- Please include a basic mock invoice for option 1 showing total committed tokens, unit price, and the resulting monthly commitment charge. Procurement will want to see it for budget approval.
- Does option 1 include a performance SLA for cold-start P99 on large-model routes? We've been sensitive to P99 in batch-to-real-time handoffs.

Procurement note: we have a hard cutover window the first week of Nov for pricing approvals. If we can get a doc with final numbers in the next 10 business days, we should be okay.

Appreciate you looping Ben + Laura — looking forward to the breakdown.

Subject: Re: Renewal sync: scaling sprint & usage runway for Satellite Labs

Alex — looping Ben and Laura in with the line-levels and a quick mutual action plan. See bullets below and the attached CSV/XLSX for source numbers.

Top-line numbers (source: billing export / internal forecast):
- July 2026: 1.2M tokens total (baseline features)
- August 2026: 2.8M tokens total (OCR + captioning spike)
- Projected September (current pacing): 3.5M tokens total; conservative Q4 plan shows ramp to ~8–10M tokens/mo without a commit.

Per-route highlights (attached CSV):
- /v1/generate-image-caption (gpt-large-image): ~45% of August tokens, high P50 but modest P95 (200–300ms)
- /v1/chat (gpt-medium-text): steady at ~35%
- Bulk ingestion (batch OCR): 20% but with high hourly peaks

Pricing sketch (see renewal_pricing_v2.xlsx for math):
- Option 1 (recommended): 40M tokens/mo commit, 25% burst pool, $0.00055/token effective ⇒ monthly commitment: $22,000; overage at $0.00075/token.
- Concession: 10% one-time onboarding credit if signed before 2026-09-20.

Mutual action plan (proposed):
1) This week: Redwood provides per-model breakout + mock invoice (attached).
2) Next week: Satellite legal/procurement reviews term & SLA; Redwood provides DocuSign link for option selection.
3) Target: signed MSA & SOW by 2026-09-28 to enable engineering runway for Q4.

Ben/Laura — can you confirm SLA language (P99 cold-start guarantee) is available under option 1 and whether we can include a 30-day performance credit if P99 exceeds X ms for large-image route? If so I'll flag that in the quote.

Thanks — attaching the three files again.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: satellite_usage_aug2026.csv, renewal_pricing_v2.xlsx, satellite_perf_report_q3.pdf
From: Procurement <procurement@satellitelabs.ai>

Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal sync: scaling sprint & usage runway for Satellite Labs

Sean / Redwood team —

Thanks for the detailed packet. After internal review we are inclined to accept Option 1 with one modification: a 9-month committed term instead of 12 (we want a shorter commit due to a pending product pivot in Q2 next year).

Requests before we sign:
- Please update the mock invoice to reflect a 9-month term with the same unit pricing and provide the DocuSign link.
- Confirm the P99 cold-start SLA for gpt-large-image route and include the 30-day performance credit clause as discussed (we propose 5% credit of monthly commitment if P99 > 400ms for two consecutive weeks).

If you can send an updated DocuSign packet by EOD Monday (2026-09-13), procurement can route for signature and we’ll aim to execute within our stated approval window.
